headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of November 17, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 9.50%, surpassing the SPY benchmark return of 8.09% by 1.41%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also effectively navigating the current market landscape. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a substantial return of 28.96%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, 'Random B' has underperformed with a return of -3.47%, marking it as the weakest portfolio. The current average alpha of 1.41% reinforces the portfolio's relative strength against SPY, highlighting its resilience during potential market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
